summary: ITER66 FRONTEND-ONLY verification of the new 'Today Mode' activity selector. ALL 7 acceptance criteria PASS end-to-end at 1280x800 (tablet landscape) against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL after logging in as greenlantern@roujaune.app. (1) 'TODAY I WANT TO' button is rendered in the left rail directly below the ROUJAUNE logo (testID today-mode-button) — verified visually and via testID. (2) Tapping opens a floating dark-glass menu with all 8 options (testIDs today-mode-option-{training|scenic-cycling|gravel|mountain-bike|walking|running|rowing|climbing}); Train today shows the selected/checkmark state; the 6 future modes each show a 'COMING SOON' badge (exactly 6 matches) and are disabled (aria-disabled=true, Pressable disabled=true) — tapping gravel is a no-op and does NOT switch mode. (3) Selecting scenic-cycling swaps the Today content to testID scenic-cycling-today with heading 'WHERE SHALL WE EXPLORE TODAY?', Lake Garda hero (testID scenic-hero, 'LAKE GARDA LAKESIDE JOURNEY' / Italy / 42 minutes / Relaxed / 8 discoveries) and the calm reminder 'Your planned workout will remain on your calendar…' — URL stays at '/' (no full reload). (4) Sidebar simultaneously swaps to the scenic experience nav: Today, Explore Destinations, Continue Journey, My Scenic Journeys, Saved Destinations, Discoveries, Companions (all 7 railnav-* testIDs present). The ROUJAUNE logo, the Today Mode selector, and Connections/Profile/Settings persist. (5) 'BEGIN SCENIC JOURNEY' (testID begin-scenic-journey) navigates to /virtual-route and renders the Alpine Sunset Pass route-picker (real content, NOT blank). 'EXPLORE DESTINATIONS' (testID explore-destinations) navigates to /routes and renders the routes screen. (6) Switching back to Train today via the menu restores the training Today content (NEXT SCHEDULED WORKOUT card with Beginner Cycling Strength for Mon 27 Jul, TRAINING PLAN 'From Couch to Road' card, Weekly Rides / Training Time / Distance / Elevation / FTP=287W / Readiness=67% metrics strip) AND swaps the rail back to Today / My Training Plan / Calendar / Workouts / Benchmark Tests / Progress / Ride History + utility (all 10 railnav-* testIDs found). Training plan data is intact — no changes to plan or scheduled workout after mode switching. (7) Tapping 'Ride History' (railnav-history, coming-soon in training) shows a toast 'Ride History — coming soon' and DOES NOT navigate (URL stays '/'). (8) REGRESSION on training rail: all 8 target nav items (My Training Plan → /plan, Calendar → /calendar, Workouts → /workouts, Benchmark Tests → /benchmark, Progress → /progress, Connections → /connections, Profile → /profile, Settings → /settings) navigate to the expected route AND the rail + Today Mode selector persist on the destination screen (verified via [data-testid=today-mode-button] on each). (9) Session persistence: after switching to scenic-cycling and hard-reloading '/', the app rehydrates in scenic-cycling mode and renders scenic-cycling-today (AsyncStorage hydration works). No red screens, no React Native crashes, no untranslated text. Testing NOT performed (out of scope per request): backend endpoints, tapping the 6 future-activity options (they are correctly disabled so their Today views are unreachable via the menu — FutureActivityTodayView code inspection confirms the 'back-to-training' testID exists but was not exercised because the menu blocks entry). No new files created; no source changes required.

issues: Minor: on 1280x800 the 'Go mountain biking' option label truncates ('Go mountain biki…') because the COMING SOON pill and the label share the same row (see screenshot i66_menu.jpeg). Not a functional bug — full label is available via aria-label — but if the design intends to keep the full label visible, consider dropping the pill to a second line for that one option or shortening its label to 'Mountain bike'.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on every screen: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Traced to the Toast component in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line 46 (and the AppScaffold Toast at /app/frontend/src/components/app-scaffold.tsx line 46) which pass pointerEvents via the style prop object alongside opacity/transform — the react-native-web bridge still flags it. Pre-existing, non-blocking, but worth migrating to style.pointerEvents for future react-native-web compatibility.

Repeating warning 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Sources include the Today Mode fade-in in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line 75 (Animated.timing({ useNativeDriver: true })) and the Toast fade in /app/frontend/src/components/app-scaffold.tsx lines 39-42. On web, useNativeDriver must be false — recommend `useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web'`. Non-blocking (animation still works via JS driver) but pollutes console.

Three SVG errors on '/' after switching back to training: 'Error: <line> attribute x1/x2: Expected length, "Infinity"' and 'Error: <text> attribute x: Expected length, "Infinity"'. Likely a chart component in the training dashboard receiving an empty/zero-width layout for one render frame. Pre-existing (not introduced by the Today Mode feature) but worth chasing separately.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish (design): 'Go mountain biking' label truncates in the menu on 1280 width. Consider shortening the label to 'Mountain bike' (matches the shortLabel already used in the rail) or wrapping the COMING SOON pill to a second line.

OPTIONAL polish (react-native-web hygiene): switch `useNativeDriver: true` in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx Toast & mode-fade and /app/frontend/src/components/app-scaffold.tsx Toast to `Platform.OS !== 'web'` to silence console warnings.
OPTIONAL polish: migrate `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` in the Toast components to clear the deprecation warning.
OPTIONAL (unrelated to this feature): investigate the 3 SVG Infinity coordinate errors on the training Today dashboard — appears to be a chart rendering with a zero/undefined width for one frame.
critical_code_review_comments: today-mode.ts is a clean, small reactive store with AsyncStorage persistence — no redux/zustand overkill for a session-scoped setting. `initTodayMode` is idempotent and hydration is best-effort (silent on failure). Good.

The eight modes and their per-experience nav are fully data-driven from a single Record<RiderExperience, ExperienceNavigation> in one file — swapping in a new experience or promoting a coming-soon item to available is a one-line change. Nice.

SideNavigation reads `useTodayMode()` and re-renders when the experience changes — the rail swap does NOT navigate or unmount the shell, matching the acceptance criterion of 'without reloading the app shell'.

Coming-soon safety is enforced at TWO layers: (a) the menu disables the Pressable and skips onSelect (TodayModeButton.tsx line 64), (b) resolveNav+onSelectNav in app-scaffold.tsx and app/index.tsx short-circuit to a toast for coming-soon rail items. Belt-and-braces — good.

FutureActivityTodayView is not currently reachable via the menu (the 6 future modes are disabled) so its 'back-to-training' escape hatch was not exercised in this run. Code inspection confirms it correctly calls setExperience('training') and testID='back-to-training' is present.

rememberRoute is called in BOTH the AppScaffold onSelect handler and the index.tsx onSelectNav handler — the last-visited-route-per-experience is retained across mode switches (best-effort persistence). Good.

Nit (not a bug): TODAY_MODES entries all use `route: '/'` except training/scenic — but neither `setExperience` nor `lastRouteFor` currently pushes to `route` on switch (the app just re-renders the Today content). So the field is effectively documentation. Fine as-is.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 acceptance criteria + full training-rail regression pass)

seed_data_creation: None. No backend writes. AsyncStorage may retain the last selected mode on the test browser — cleared on next fresh session anyway.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works. To retest, log in as greenlantern@roujaune.app / rideon9900 at https://scenic-trainer.preview.emergentagent.com/, viewport 1280x800. Key testIDs: today-mode-button (rail), today-mode-option-<id> (menu, 8 total), scenic-cycling-today, scenic-hero, begin-scenic-journey → /virtual-route, explore-destinations → /routes, back-to-training (only visible if you enter a future mode, which requires temporarily flipping availability to 'available' in /app/frontend/src/lib/today-mode.ts). Regression targets: railnav-{home,training,calendar,workouts,benchmark,progress,history,connections,profile,settings} in training; railnav-{home,explore,continue,journeys,saved,discoveries,companions} in scenic-cycling.
